:::{#def-realization}
#### Realization (observed value)

A **realization** of a [random variable](#def-random-variable) $X$
is the value $x = X(\outcome)$ it takes
at the point $\outcome$ of the [sample space](probability-basics.qmd#def-sample-space) that the [random experiment](probability-basics.qmd#def-random-experiment) produced.

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

The [random variable](#def-random-variable) $X$ is the rule, before the experiment is run;
the realization $x$ is one number, after it is run.
Probabilities such as $\Pr(X = x)$ describe the rule,
and a realization is a fixed number.

:::
